label: Crema catalana
note: Cooked on the hob (not baked) with cinnamon and lemon zest, usually thickened with cornflour, chilled, then caramelised on top; made from milk, egg yolks, sugar; cannot be frozen

about.text: A Catalan custard of milk, egg yolks and sugar with a burnt-sugar crust.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Unlike crème brûlée it is cooked on the hob, not baked, and the cornstarch lets it be brought to the boil without curdling. Traditionally the sugar is burnt with a hot iron (cremador). Quantities are one blog recipe (Manu's Menu); ratios differ between recipes.

steps.note: Until it boils and thickens, the foam gone.
To room temperature, then the fridge, not frozen.

steps.name: burn
steps.note: Sugar, about 1/2 tbsp per portion, burnt with a torch.
